supersedes.reason: Version 3 cleared the score-group lifecycle blocker but produced ten zero-signal batches because unconstrained text generation did not realize a useful finite action policy.

scope.purpose: Prove that the 4B LoRA Stage C path completes one exact-snapshot ReDCO update with a valid finite categorical branch action policy.

categorical_action_policy.representation: one exact decimal digit and no other generated text
categorical_action_policy.tokenizer_validation: AutoTokenizer(Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507).encode(digit, add_special_tokens=false) returned one token per mapping before freeze

decoder.allowed_token_ids: the exact subset corresponding to the current probe's actions

categorical_action_policy.semantics: vLLM masks logits outside allowed_token_ids and samples one token from the renormalized on-policy finite action distribution. Every branch in an episode receives the same prompt and allowed action set.

hardware.spot_policy: reject the resource if provisioning identifies it as spot or preemptible
prohibited: a second simultaneous Stage C pod

resource_policy.stop_if_v2_lifecycle_error_recurs: ValueError: clean Stage C permits one collected group per snapshot

mandatory: all frozen source hashes match locally and remotely
exactly two complete effective episodes and ten effective traces are serialized
all collected traces form complete five-trace episodes under policy version zero
each effective episode contains one context and branch indices zero through three
each effective branch records one valid categorical action, the frozen temperature, its allowed token ids, a distinct structural seed, and a distinct cache salt
at least one effective episode has nonconstant counterfactual branch rewards
every target is committed before action sampling
all effective branch records report exact sliced/full reward equivalence
the optimizer gradient norm is finite and positive
a non-empty LoRA adapter is saved
decision_rule.failure: sync all artifacts, emit a signed structured failure, terminate compute, and do not start a learning arm
